text: D215445 requests matching special-UID test copies after testModifyItemWithNoChanges in the cached and uncached files; landed/current code applies that organization. Both tasks still call createCalendar(..., false), and the shared factory assigns that value to cache.enabled. The manager only adds an offline calCachedCalendar facade when cache.enabled or cache.always is true; fresh CalDAV setup does not force cache.always. Both tasks therefore use the uncached configuration, which still has internal memory storage. Each registers onLoad/onAddItem before addItem, waits Promise.any, retrieves the original UID, then deletes/unregisters. Proposed repair: enable caching in the cached task, register/wait for initial synchronization as nearby cached tests do, then reset completion waits for the add operation and run both modes. Write the Assert.ok lookup message as "The event should be stored with its original UID." The old negative message states the opposite expected result. File duplication and acceptance do not prove runtime coverage. No test or source edit was performed here.
title: Check the factory argument before claiming cached CalDAV coverage
